messages:
Priya Sharma: FYI - onboarding pipeline stalled for ~18 tenants (indexing + auth flaps) starting 02:10 UTC. Drafted a customer note and tiered credit offer, need quick reviews before morning send.
Sam Ortega: Paste draft + affected tenant IDs? i'll cross-ref renewals after.
Priya Sharma: Affected: T-1012, T-1045, T-1099, T-1101, T-1120, T-1155 + 11 trials. Draft: "Hi — we detected a temporary onboarding failure affecting your index and auth flow. We're actively repairing your index and expect completion within 8 hours. We're applying an onboarding credit based on plan tier and offering a dedicated office hours slot. Reply if you'd like priority hands-on help."
Maya Chen: Good start. Add exact ETA window and simple bullets: (1) what happened, (2) what we did, (3) what to expect. Link to onboarding FAQ.
Priya Sharma: Updated. ETA: completion by EOD UTC (approx 8h). Link: https://redwood.example.com/docs/onboard-faq
Jon Patel: Root cause: race in indexing worker when auth returns 401 during db write. Hotfix queued to limit retry churn and prioritize initial prefixes. Full fix next week.
Sam Ortega: Flag any tenant with activation date >30 days and MRR >$5k as RenewalRisk. Those get Tier A outreach (personal CS + credit + engineer).
Priya Sharma: Proposed credit tiers: Tier A: $2,000 + 3h eng support; Tier B: $500 + office hours; Tier C: $50 credit. Agree?
Maya Chen: Yes. Also add a 1-question feedback link in the note (helpful/not helpful) and capture replies in the shared sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/OnboardFeedback
Priya Sharma: Action list: Sam - produce priority list + renewal tags (ETA 60m). Maya - prepare credit ops playbook and templated refunds (ETA 3h). Jon - push hotfix branch and canary (ETA 6h). Priya - finalize copy and schedule send at 08:00 local for affected regions.
Sam Ortega: On it. Will also set up a Zap to flag inbound replies with "activation" or "blocked" terms into this thread.
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0423-17. Priority P2. Assigned: eng-runtime, cs-ops.
Maya Chen: Small copy tweak - replace vague "one-time credit" with amounts to avoid back-and-forth.
Priya Sharma: Done in draft. Also adding in-app banner + scheduling link for enterprise calls.
Jon Patel: Engineering note: if canary shows >50% reduction in retries, we'll rollout to all clusters. Monitoring queries: retry_rate and index_throughput.
Priya Sharma: Please keep replies succinct. Route billing/legal asks to me. I'll own any exec-level comms if renewals escalate.
CS Ops Bot: Reminder set for 48h after send to collect feedback and compile customer recap.
Sam Ortega: Final check: I'll send priority list and renewal flags in 45m.
Maya Chen: I'll publish office-hours calendar once draft is final.
Priya Sharma: Thanks team — sending plan is email + in-app banner + office hours link. Will post a short customer summary here after send and schedule 48h follow-up. :thumbsup:
Sam Ortega: ack, thanks.
